wholePhysicalScope: The named native church outline locates both long nave walls and the narrower west choir, with the neighbouring museum and hotel footprints fixing the ranges. The seven mapped fragments establish the layout of the low ruins west of the church.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the two-pitch abbey church, surviving ranges and low convent remains.
limitations: The standing envelopes, separate ranges and surviving walls follow their mapped positions. Eaves, flèche and individual buttress depths are approximate.
The abbey church’s two eastern portals, pointed tracery and tiered slate roofs follow the surviving church. Secondary masonry openings and the 1926 sacristy dimensions are generalized.

The former palace and nuns’ wings are based on mapped ranges and owner material descriptions. Their exact window spacing, minor roof details and individual ruins’ surviving heights are approximations.
